_about: Where Hermes lives (krew-hermes-home-20261101, the owner 2026-11-01): crew/lib/krew_hermes.py is the one rule (hermes_home / kanban_dir / hermes_tree / runtime_python), copied byte for byte beside every krew folder that needs it (a plugin is installed alone), crew/lib/krew_hermes.sh its shell half; tests/test_hermes_home.py holds the copies identical and refuses a built ~/.hermes path anywhere else. The copies in folders another package already globs (janitor, ms/lib, rails, window/lib) ship with that package.

hermes-home.about: The rule and its copies: crew/lib/krew_hermes.py (+ .sh), and the copies beside the panel, the plugins that build Hermes paths, scripts/ and two skills' scripts.
